Container.Name: Geotagger
Container.Overview: Geotags photos from your Dawarich location history (or GPX files). Each photo is matched using its own EXIF timezone. JPG gets GPS in the file, RAW gets a .xmp sidecar. Dry run first, then write.

Config.Name: Photo library
Config.Description: Folder with your photos. Read-write: GPS is written into JPGs and .xmp sidecars.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Jobs, settings, your manual placements, thumbnails

Config.Name: Dawarich URL
Config.Description: Base URL of Dawarich, e.g. https://dawarich.example.com. Can also be set in the app's Settings page.

Config.Name: Dawarich API key
Config.Description: Dawarich → Account → API key. Can also be set in the app's Settings page.

Config.Name: Photo roots
Config.Description: Comma-separated container paths the app may browse. Add a path mapping for each extra library and list it here.
